headline: GTCO Reports Pre-Tax Profit of N879.9 Billion for First Nine Months
summary: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc (GTCO) released nine-month financial results showing a pre-tax profit of 879.9 billion naira. The Nigerian financial services group reported continued asset expansion across its banking subsidiaries.
why: GTCO is one of Nigeria's largest and most profitable financial institutions, serving as a key bellwether for West African banking sector health.
